exact_statement: For every uniform Boolean sign f and nonempty proper block A of size r, K>0, let sigma=I_A(f), g_x be all complete children, a(g) their minimum affine-input/output-character influence, Rchild=E I(g)-E a(g)>=0, S*=E[Ka(g)-H(g)] and D=H(f)-KI(f), with entropy bits. Then D+S*+K Rchild=H(f)-E H(g)-K sigma <= r[h2(sigma/r)-(K-2/ln2)sigma/r] <= r log2(1+exp(2)2^(-K)) <= r log2(1+2^(3-K)). If f has positive D, all n coordinates essential, and least essential dimension among positive-deficit signs at the SAME K, then S*>=0, sigma>0, sigma<exp(3)r2^(-K), and D,S*,K Rchild are each bounded by that same full capacity (strict for the last two). No phase price Pi or old debit is removed. Universal query selection and FEI remain open.
